name: GuideLink
description: Keeps canonical IPTV channels aligned, reports availability, and guards scrubber/failover continuity.

ui_tables.label: Profiles
ui_tables.description: Settings for assigned playlists. Saving a profile does not run a sync. Use Preview Sync to review changes, then Run Sync to apply them, or wait for a scheduled sync configured to apply changes.

fields.label: Profile details
Profile name
fields.helper_text: Give this profile a name you will recognise when assigning it to playlists.

fields.label: Use this profile
fields.helper_text: Allow GuideLink to use this profile for setup, reports and syncs. Turning it off keeps the profile and previously applied playlist changes.

fields.description: Saving changes this profile only. Use Preview Sync to review the saved settings, then Run Sync to apply them, or wait for a scheduled sync configured to apply changes.

fields.label: Lineup & programme guide
fields.description: Choose the reference lineup and numbered programme guide used to identify its channels.

fields.label: Lineup source
fields.helper_text: Use a supported listings website or an existing playlist for channel names, numbers and groups. Both options need a numbered programme guide.

fields.label: Country
fields.helper_text: Choose the country whose channel naming rules and lineup sources GuideLink should use.

fields.label: Programme guide (EPG)
fields.helper_text: Select a guide with channel numbers that match the lineup. GuideLink uses it to validate matches and assign consistent guide identities.

fields.label: Website lineup
fields.description: Used when Lineup source is Listings website.

fields.label: Lineup provider
fields.helper_text: Choose the television lineup to follow, such as Sky. This is the lineup provider, not your IPTV account provider.

fields.label: Listings website
fields.helper_text: Choose the website that supplies the selected provider's channel lineup.

fields.label: Lineup region
fields.helper_text: Enter the provider's region number or exact region name to select the local channel lineup. For Sky, region 7 is Granada.

fields.label: Reference playlist
fields.helper_text: When the lineup source is Another playlist, choose the playlist to copy the lineup from. Only enabled live channels with usable channel numbers are included.

fields.label: Downloads & source checks
fields.description: For Listings website sources: configure downloads and protect the saved lineup from incomplete results. Another playlist does not use these options.

fields.label: Download method
fields.helper_text: Download directly, or use a supported download service when the listings website blocks direct requests.

fields.label: Download service API key
fields.helper_text: Enter the API key for the selected download service. Direct HTTP does not need a key.

fields.label: Download timeout (seconds)
fields.helper_text: Maximum time to wait for each page request. A lineup refresh can download several pages.

fields.label: Reuse downloaded lineup for (days)
fields.helper_text: During a source refresh, reuse a saved lineup younger than this age. Set to 0 to download on every refresh. This does not schedule refreshes.

fields.label: Download attempts
fields.helper_text: Maximum attempts for each page, including the first request. Some errors stop attempts early; GuideLink can fall back to a valid saved lineup.

fields.label: Minimum lineup size
fields.helper_text: Reject downloaded or saved website lineups with fewer channels than this. Choose a minimum below the normal size of your lineup.

fields.label: Maximum lineup reduction (%)
fields.helper_text: Keep the previous saved lineup if a refresh loses more than this percentage of its channels.

fields.label: Channel handling
fields.description: Choose how confirmed matches are organised and what happens to unconfirmed channels. A suggestion needing review is not a confirmed match.

fields.label: Use lineup groups
fields.helper_text: Move matched channels into the lineup's groups and maintain their group order. When off, GuideLink leaves group assignments and group setup unchanged.

fields.label: Channel logos
fields.helper_text: Choose the logo preference for matched channels, including disabled backups. Custom logo overrides are kept; missing guide logos fall back to provider logos.

fields.label: Manage playlist layout & imports
fields.helper_text: On Run Sync or a scheduled sync that applies changes, manage playlist ordering, numbering and new live imports. Turn off automatic channel/group sorting and forced numbering; apply the choices below. Ordering and numbering affect the whole playlist, including VOD. Turning this off keeps the last applied settings.

fields.label: Disable channels without a confirmed match
fields.helper_text: When you run Run Sync, or a scheduled sync applies changes, disable unconfirmed channels, including review suggestions and excluded channels. Exceptions below are kept. With Use lineup groups on, also disable eligible provider groups left empty or containing only channels disabled by this policy. Turning this off does not re-enable channels or groups.

fields.label: Enable newly imported live channels
fields.helper_text: While Manage playlist layout & imports is on, enable live channels discovered in future provider imports. This import setting does not change existing channels. Run Sync separately recovers confirmed matches and applies the unmatched-channel policy.

fields.label: Groups to leave unchanged
fields.helper_text: Enter exact group names. GuideLink leaves their matching, metadata and channel/group cleanup unchanged. These exceptions do not undo earlier changes or stop playlist imports and stream checks.

fields.label: Pattern-based exceptions
fields.description: Leave matching groups or channels unchanged by GuideLink. These exceptions do not stop other playlist jobs or undo earlier changes. Use regular expressions, not wildcard patterns.

fields.label: Groups to leave unchanged — name patterns
fields.helper_text: Leave matching groups and their channels unchanged during GuideLink matching and cleanup. Enter one regular expression per tag.

fields.label: Channels to leave unchanged — name patterns
fields.helper_text: Leave channels with matching titles unchanged during GuideLink matching and cleanup. Enter one regular expression per tag.

fields.label: Which groups to match
fields.description: Limit matching attempts. Skipped channels can still be disabled by the unmatched-channel policy; use exceptions to leave them unchanged.

fields.label: Match groups starting with
fields.helper_text: Enter group-name prefixes, such as UK|, or leave blank for no prefix restriction. Lineup groups are also included when Use lineup groups is on.

fields.label: Skip matching groups — name patterns
fields.helper_text: Skip matching channels in groups whose names match these regular expressions. These channels can still be disabled by the unmatched-channel policy; use Exceptions to leave them unchanged.

fields.label: Ordering & numbering
fields.description: Used while Manage playlist layout & imports is on. These preferences affect the whole assigned playlist, including VOD.

fields.label: Playlist order
fields.helper_text: Output a single list in channel-number order, or keep groups together with channels ordered inside each group.

fields.label: Automatic numbers for unnumbered channels
fields.helper_text: Control automatic numbering for channels without a saved number. Existing guide numbers and the playlist's starting number are kept. Number-based TVG IDs may still require a number when this is off.

fields.label: Channel-name alias sets
fields.helper_text: Add shared alternative channel names to matching. Choose compatible sets from Data → Alias Sets; their country and target channels must match this profile's guide.

fields.label: Matching rules
fields.description: Standard values are usually suitable. Scores are comparison points, not probabilities. Preview Sync after changing these rules to inspect the results.

fields.label: Minimum name similarity
fields.helper_text: Minimum similarity for an approximate name comparison to become a candidate. Higher values accept fewer name variations; lower values allow more candidates.

fields.label: Minimum automatic-match score
fields.helper_text: Minimum score for accepting scored matches automatically. Higher values can send more candidates for review; exact matches and other identity rules follow their own checks.

fields.label: Required lead over next candidate
fields.helper_text: Normally require the best approximate match to lead the next candidate by this many points. Higher values send more close matches for review.

fields.label: Word-order score allowance
fields.helper_text: Allow the supporting word-order comparison score to fall this many points below Minimum name similarity. Higher values make some approximate matching paths more permissive.

fields.label: Minimum lineup-name words for word-set matching
fields.helper_text: Require this many words in the lineup name before comparing shared word sets. Higher values limit this method to longer lineup names.

fields.label: Minimum full-name length ratio
fields.helper_text: For full-name comparison, require the shorter name to be at least this fraction of the longer name. Higher values allow less difference in length; 0.70 means 70%.

fields.label: Full-name score without supporting word match
fields.helper_text: Require this full-name score when the supporting word-order score is too low. Higher values make this route stricter; Minimum name similarity still applies.

fields.label: Minimum partial-name length ratio
fields.helper_text: Before comparing part of a name, require the shorter name to be at least this fraction of the longer name. Higher values allow less difference in length; 0.65 means 65%.

fields.label: Minimum partial-name length
fields.helper_text: Require both names to contain at least this many characters before partial-name comparison. Higher values prevent this method from using very short names.

fields.label: Supporting full-name score for partial matches
fields.helper_text: Require this full-name similarity before accepting evidence from a partial-name comparison. Higher values make partial matching stricter.

fields.label: Minimum words for derived name variants
fields.helper_text: Use this word count when checking automatically derived name variants. Higher values limit variants that are too short to identify a channel reliably.

fields.label: Minimum characters for derived name variants
fields.helper_text: Use this character count to guard shortened or derived name variants. Higher values reject more short variants and broadcaster-prefix shortcuts.

fields.label: Short-word safeguard length
fields.helper_text: Treat abbreviations up to this length more cautiously. Higher values extend the safeguard to longer words and can send more ambiguous names for review.

fields.label: Minimum similarity for spelling differences
fields.helper_text: Require this similarity before treating differing words as a small spelling variation. Higher values make the distinguishing-word check stricter.

fields.label: Backups & stream health
fields.description: Choose the primary stream for playback and backups for failover. Run Sync saves these settings; playlist imports and stream checks perform the processing. Run Sync does not itself start a scan or rebuild backups.

fields.label: Preferred stream playlist
fields.helper_text: Prefer primary streams from this playlist. Leave blank to use each assigned playlist. Catch-up and resolution preferences can take priority.

fields.label: Backup playlists
fields.helper_text: Choose additional playlists in priority order for backup streams. Leave empty to use channels from the assigned playlist only.

fields.label: Hide backup entries
fields.helper_text: Keep backup streams available for failover while disabling their separate playlist entries. Applies during GuideLink sync recovery and native backup processing.

fields.label: Primary stream selection
fields.description: Refine which eligible stream m3u-editor chooses for normal playback.

fields.label: Prefer higher resolution
fields.helper_text: Prefer higher-resolution streams when choosing the primary stream. Run Sync also enables live-stream metadata probing after provider imports, preserving its scope and other options. Turning this preference off leaves probing unchanged. GuideLink sync uses saved statistics; native merge jobs may probe when needed.

fields.label: Prefer catch-up support
fields.helper_text: Prefer eligible streams with catch-up support before applying resolution and playlist preferences.

fields.label: Avoid primary streams from disabled groups
fields.helper_text: Exclude channels in disabled groups when choosing a primary stream.

fields.label: Avoid primary streams that failed checks
fields.helper_text: Exclude failed streams during native primary selection. GuideLink sync recovery always keeps known-dead entries off. Uses saved health results; does not start a new check.

fields.label: Backup matching & rebuilds
fields.description: Configure how m3u-editor groups equivalent streams when its backup processing runs.

fields.label: Only process newly imported channels
fields.helper_text: Limit backup processing to channels marked as new by m3u-editor. Leave off to include existing eligible channels too.

fields.label: Reconsider existing backup assignments
fields.helper_text: Allow existing backup streams to be reconsidered during the next merge. The new-channels-only restriction still applies when enabled.

fields.label: Match backup streams by
fields.helper_text: Choose the identifier m3u-editor uses to group matching streams. Stream ID is the normal choice for GuideLink live channels; TMDB ID requires matching TMDB metadata.

fields.label: Stream checker
fields.helper_text: Leave blank for GuideLink to create or reuse its checker for each assigned playlist. A selected checker must belong to that playlist. GuideLink only changes checkers it manages; edit a user-managed checker in m3u-editor's Channel Scrubbers screen.

fields.label: Check streams after playlist import
fields.helper_text: Run the managed stream checker after m3u-editor imports or refreshes the provider playlist. This is separate from a GuideLink metadata sync.

fields.label: Disable streams that fail checks
fields.helper_text: Let the managed checker disable channel entries whose streams fail its check. When off, it still records the results without disabling those entries.

fields.label: Stream-check options
fields.description: Settings for the GuideLink-managed checker. Saved values are kept when you select a user-managed checker.

fields.label: Include disabled channels in checks
fields.helper_text: Check disabled live channels as well as enabled ones, so backup selection can use their latest health results. Checking a recovered stream does not directly re-enable its entry.

fields.label: Rebuild backups after a successful scan
fields.helper_text: After the checker completes successfully, rerun m3u-editor's backup selection using the updated health results.

fields.label: Stream-check method
fields.helper_text: Use an HTTP response check for a quick availability check, or FFprobe to inspect the media stream.

fields.label: Stream-check timeout (seconds)
fields.helper_text: Maximum time allowed for each stream check. Longer timeouts give slow streams more time to respond and can make a scan take longer.

fields.label: Include stream-health evidence in reports
fields.helper_text: Include available stream-check history in channel availability and repair reports. This does not enable, disable or start stream checks.

ui_tables.label: Playlists
ui_tables.description: Assign profiles to playlists and choose which automatic tasks include them. Both the profile and its playlist assignment must be enabled. Clearing an assignment does not delete the playlist.
ui_tables.delete_description: This clears the GuideLink profile and disables this playlist assignment without removing the playlist from the table.

fields.label: Playlist
fields.helper_text: Prefilled from your playlists. Choose the playlist this GuideLink assignment controls.

fields.label: GuideLink profile
fields.helper_text: Choose an enabled profile, or leave blank to keep this playlist unassigned.

fields.label: Use GuideLink for this playlist
fields.helper_text: Allow this assignment to participate in GuideLink setup, reports and syncs. Turning it off keeps earlier playlist changes.

fields.label: Include in automatic and batch syncs
fields.helper_text: Include this playlist in scheduled syncs and sync actions targeting assigned playlists.

fields.label: Include in automatic and batch checks
fields.helper_text: Include this playlist in scheduled, post-import and assigned-playlist channel checks. An explicitly selected manual check can still run.

ui_tables.label: Results
ui_tables.description: Native audit rows from plugin runs.

ui_tables.label: Alias Sets
ui_tables.description: Shared collections of alternative channel names. Select these sets in a profile to use them for matching.

fields.label: Alias set name
fields.helper_text: Give this shared collection of alternative channel names a recognisable name.

fields.label: Included alias dataset
fields.helper_text: Choose a read-only dataset shipped with GuideLink, or leave blank to maintain your own names in Data → Aliases. Plugin updates replace bundled data. Inspect included names with Preview Alias Set.

fields.label: Country
fields.helper_text: Choose the country whose naming rules apply. Profiles using this set must use the same country.

fields.label: Reference programme guide
fields.helper_text: Choose the guide used to select this set's target channels. Reusing it with another guide requires compatible channel identities.

fields.label: Make this alias set available
fields.helper_text: Allow profiles to use this set. Remove a disabled set from profiles that still select it before running them.

ui_tables.label: Aliases
ui_tables.description: Alternative channel names for custom alias sets. Included datasets are read-only; inspect them with Preview Alias Set.

fields.label: Custom alias sets
fields.helper_text: Add this entry to one or more compatible custom sets. Shared edits affect every selected set.

fields.label: Target guide channel
fields.helper_text: Choose the channel these alternative names should identify.

fields.label: Alternative channel names
fields.helper_text: Enter one complete name per tag. Add +1 channel names against their own +1 guide entry.

fields.label: Use these alternative names
fields.helper_text: Include this entry when matching with its selected custom sets.

settings.label: Scheduling
settings.description: Choose which automatic tasks run. Channel checks report availability; only a sync configured to Apply changes updates playlists.

fields.label: Check channels on a schedule
fields.helper_text: Run availability reports for eligible playlist assignments at the channel-check schedule.

fields.label: Sync playlists on a schedule
fields.helper_text: Run GuideLink sync for eligible playlist assignments at the sync schedule.

fields.label: Scheduled sync behavior
fields.helper_text: Choose Preview changes to record proposed edits, or Apply changes to update playlists.

fields.label: Refresh website lineups on a schedule
fields.helper_text: Refresh website lineups used by enabled profiles at the source-refresh schedule. Each profile may reuse a recent saved lineup instead of downloading again.

fields.label: Schedule times
fields.description: Cron expressions use m3u-editor's scheduler timezone. Changing a schedule does not immediately start a run.

fields.label: Channel-check schedule
fields.helper_text: Cron expression for availability reports. The default runs once per hour.

fields.label: Playlist-sync schedule
fields.helper_text: Cron expression for GuideLink sync. The default runs daily at 03:00 in the scheduler's timezone.

fields.label: Lineup-refresh schedule
fields.helper_text: Cron expression for source refreshes. The default runs daily at 02:30 in the scheduler's timezone.

settings.label: Alerts
settings.description: Use m3u-editor's notifications and configured alert destinations.

fields.label: Notify about problems and recovery
fields.helper_text: Report failures, saved-lineup fallback and recovery through m3u-editor notifications and its configured alert channels. Preview and scheduled report failures are included.

fields.label: Reminder options
fields.description: An elapsed interval alone does not send a reminder; GuideLink must observe the problem again.

fields.label: Unresolved-problem reminder interval (hours)
fields.helper_text: Send another reminder when the same problem is seen after this interval (1–168 hours). New problems, worsening incidents and recovery are reported immediately. Recovery also follows the host notification preferences.

fields.label: Run For Assigned Playlists
fields.helper_text: Run this action for every enabled playlist assignment instead of one selected playlist.

fields.label: Playlist
fields.helper_text: Preview profile settings, channel matching, quarantine and recovery candidates. Does not start a scan or change channels.

fields.label: Run For Assigned Playlists
fields.helper_text: Run this action for every enabled playlist assignment instead of one selected playlist.

fields.label: Playlist
fields.helper_text: Apply profile settings, update channel metadata and quarantine, then recover confirmed matches as primaries or backups. Uses saved stream-check results; does not start a scan.

fields.label: Preferred Playlist
fields.helper_text: Preferred source of primary streams when merging playlists. Defaults to this playlist. Catch-up preference and resolution can take priority.

fields.label: Failover Playlist IDs
fields.helper_text: Playlist IDs to include as native failover sources, in priority order.

fields.label: Deactivate Failover Channels
fields.helper_text: During native auto-merge, disable backup/failover channels after a master is selected so only the chosen master stays visible.

fields.label: Prioritize By Resolution
fields.helper_text: Prefer higher-resolution streams during native primary selection. Uses stream statistics and may probe streams when needed.

fields.label: Prefer Catch-up As Primary
fields.helper_text: Prefer eligible catch-up streams first, then apply resolution and playlist preferences.

fields.label: Exclude Disabled Groups From Master Selection
Scrubber-aware Primary Selection
fields.helper_text: Exclude channels confirmed dead by the scrubber when choosing the primary channel.

fields.helper_text: Keeps last_scrubber_live fresh for disabled failover-topology channels so native auto-merge can recover them safely.

fields.label: Rebuild Failovers After Scan
fields.helper_text: After a successful scrubber scan, rerun native auto-merge with fresh health state so promotions and failover recovery stay topology-aware.
